summary: Frontend-only test of the Parts/Labor split on Work Order detail (CL-2026-00067 active, CL-2026-00065 invoiced), at 1920px and 390px. Everything works: the old 'Lucrări & piese' tab is gone. Piese(n)/Manoperă(n) tab counts and the totals bar (VAT 21%) update correctly after add and delete. A stock product gets the sale price as default (520). A free item needs a description (button disabled without one). Labor uses Settings rates (electrician 200, senior 180) and the calc shows '1,5 h × 200 = 300,00 RON'. Parts and labor rows each show only in their own table. The invoiced WO shows tables with no forms or delete buttons. RO/EN toggle works. Quote creation (2 lines, 600,16), QC, Time, Reception and History tabs all still work. Found 3 mobile layout issues and one missing translation.

ui_bugs.issue: TabsList uses flex-wrap, but the shadcn TabsList has a fixed height (h-9). The second row of tabs (Control calitate / Pontaj / Recepție / Istoric) spills out and overlaps the 'Piese & consumabile' section header. Fix: add h-auto to TabsList className (or make it scroll horizontally: overflow-x-auto + flex-nowrap).
At 390px the 'Adaugă manoperă' button sits in a single grid column. Its text overflows past the button edge. Fix: col-span-2 on mobile (e.g. 'col-span-2 lg:col-span-1') or w-full.

The table shrinks to fit 390px instead of scrolling. The code 'BU-HC-040' wraps onto 3 lines and '4 buc' / '79,00 RON' also wrap, so it looks cramped. Fix: add min-w-[640px] to the table or whitespace-nowrap to the cells (overflow-x-auto wrapper already exists). labor-table scrolls fine.

issues: Header 'Cod' is hardcoded and not translated (EN shows 'COD'; should be 'Code'). 'Disc.' is also hardcoded but works in both languages.

action_items: Fix TabsList overflow/overlap on mobile (add h-auto with flex-wrap, or use horizontal scroll)
Make add-labor-button full width (col-span-2) on mobile
Give parts-table a min width / nowrap so it scrolls horizontally on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: Console warning: a <span> inside <option> (hydration warning). It comes from the visual-editor instrumentation wrapping {p.code} · {p.name} in the product select. Not caused by app code; to avoid it, build the option label as a single template string.
LineSections.js is well split (PartsSection/LaborSection/TotalsBar). /mechanics and /settings are fetched again in LaborSection and in DetailsPanel, so the requests are duplicated. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all functional checks pass; 3 mobile layout issues)
